additional_atomicity_issue.original_scan: sqlCensusSources includes system_backup_v2_evidence and chunks; scanTable hashes every exact row/column, locked Recheck expects whole facts unchanged.
additional_atomicity_issue.receipt_reader: readCoverageOwnerEvidence consumes new inline catalog_scan_receipt rows from that same evidence table.
additional_atomicity_issue.failure_trigger: Scanning source -> staging own16 witness+adoption -> calling unchanged LockedSQLCoverageCensus.Recheck fails because legitimate own receipt rows changed the source census. Staging placeholders before census and replacing signed payload has the same full-row hash change.
additional_atomicity_issue.required_resolution: Retain full original range locks and original complete pre-write facts. Original adopter must carry an opaque exact journal of its own actually staged, authenticated control evidence writes, verify each complete resulting row/chunk pin and compare every remaining original source row unchanged in final same-tx source scan. Alternatively a separately reviewed exact metadata-control disposition/storage protocol may be used. Neither a caller-provided skip-ID list nor excluding the entire evidence/chunks tables is sufficient.
additional_atomicity_issue.proposed_not_implemented: An original same-tx adoption/evidence writer can privately produce the allowed-write journal, keyed by exact owned generated record IDs and authenticated purpose/domain/issuer/payload/expiry/target/chunk values. SQL census then accounts only those legitimate writes explicitly while still consuming full EOF and holding original ranges. This avoids self-hashing without blessing caller DTOs. No such journal or exact reconciliation implementation currently delivered.
additional_atomicity_issue.certainty: This is a failure in the naive proposed producer chain, not a claim that all possible adoption protocols are impossible.
